levels.name: Crosswinds
levels.mechanicNotes: Every 3 player-initiated matches, gravity rotates and the middle row and column clear for 0 points. They glow one match before clearing. Cascades from that clear earn 5x points. Boss: the next gravity direction is unpredictable.
levels.bossRule: Gravity turns to an unpredictable different direction. It stays hidden until the turn.

levels.name: Golden Rescue
levels.mechanicNotes: Every 2 tiles in each match cage one uncaged animal (6 tiles = 3 cages). Match directly beside a cage to free its tile. Freed tiles have gold borders, give 3x block credit, keep their bonus when swapped, and cannot be recaged. New tiles are unbuffed. Boss: every matched tile cages one animal. Cascades also cage and rescue animals.
levels.bossRule: Every tile matched cages one animal instead of every two. Freed gold tiles still give 3x block credit and cannot be caged again.
levels.draftNotes: Tag-based opening: permanent block-credit growth, block credits and extra clears. Later offers retain level themes and runtime compatibility checks.

levels.name: Wild Release
levels.mechanicNotes: Make 10 matches directly beside the cage to open it. Feed an animal to score every animal of its type and remove that type from the refill pool for the rest of the round. The cage moves and resets. It rests when only 3 animal types remain. Captured types return next round or on retry. Cascades charge the cage. Feeding costs one move.
levels.draftNotes: Tag-based opening: permanent base growth, multiplier, score boost. Later offers retain level themes and runtime compatibility checks.

levels.name: Blackout
levels.mechanicNotes: Every 5 player matches, unprotected squares go black. Clearing darkness colors a square green and protects it for the rest of the round. Matches reveal replacement squares and adjacent neighbors; cascades reveal squares too. Boss: only replacement squares are revealed.
levels.bossRule: Matches reveal only replacement tiles. Adjacent tiles stay hidden. The whole board goes black every 5 player matches.
levels.draftNotes: Tag-based opening: permanent base growth, multiplier, score boost. Later offers retain level themes and runtime compatibility checks.

levels.name: Animal Spotlight
levels.mechanicNotes: Two animal types are dark; all others are visible. Every 5 player matches, the next two animal types become dark after the play finishes. Hidden animals still match. Cascades do not advance the counter.
levels.draftNotes: Tag-based opening: permanent base growth, multiplier, score boost. Later offers retain level themes and runtime compatibility checks.

levels.name: Rolling Darkness
levels.mechanicNotes: Every 2 tiles in player-created matches darken 1 square after the play finishes. Odd tiles carry over. Darkness advances through alternating rows and columns, skipping already dark squares. Matches reveal replacement tiles and adjacent neighbors. Cascades reveal tiles without spreading darkness.
levels.draftNotes: Tag-based opening: permanent base growth, multiplier, score boost. Later offers retain level themes and runtime compatibility checks.

levels.name: Lightning Rods
levels.mechanicNotes: Three fixed lightning rods each need 3 charges. Each matched tile directly beside a rod adds 1 charge; touching three sides can fill it in one match. Cascades count. When all three are full, lightning chains through them after the play settles and charges every animal square for 2x points until it clears. The rods reset and can charge again.
